# tapo-mcp

> MCP server for TP-Link Tapo cameras and smart plugs.

## Key Links

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) — Full reference

## Quick Start

```powershell
cp .env.example .env
.\start.ps1
```

## Tools

- `tapo_plug` — List, status, toggle, energy_history
- `tapo_camera` — List, status, snapshot, ptz, privacy_mode, led, stream
- `tapo_register_camera` — Register a camera by host/password

## Ports

| Service | Port |
|---------|------|
| Backend | 11102 |
| Frontend | 11103 |
